# Labels

Create these labels in the repository settings (Issues, Labels). Issue forms and the contributing guide
refer to them.

| Label              | Colour    | Description                                             |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | A small, well-scoped task that is friendly to newcomers |
| `new-game`         | `#1d76db` | Proposal or pull request for a new game                 |
| `a11y`             | `#0e8a16` | Accessibility problem or improvement                    |
| `bug`              | `#d73a4a` | Something is not working                                |
| `enhancement`      | `#a2eeef` | New feature or improvement                              |
